- [USER] User inquires about popular bhajans dedicated to Lord Ganesha.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Popular bhajans dedicated to Lord Ganesha include "Ganesh Chalisa," "Sukhkarta Dukhharta," "Vakratunda Mahakaya," "Jai Ganesh Deva," "Ganesha Sharanam," "Om Gan Ganpataye Namah," "Ganeshaya Dheemahi," and "Morya Re Bappa Morya Re."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant notes that these bhajans are often recited with devotion and can be found online with lyrics and music for singing along.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant highlights that music is a wonderful way to connect with the divine and encourages the user to enjoy exploring devotional music.
- [USER] User mentions hearing about people getting tattoos of Lord Ganesha as a form of devotion and asks for the assistant's thoughts on it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that some people express their devotion through tattoos of Lord Ganesha, noting that while tattoos are not expressly forbidden in Hinduism, they can be discouraged depending on the sect.
